'''Magde Aybara''' was [[Perrin]]'s aunt. She was married to [[Eward Aybara]].

== Appearance ==
She was stout and looked very similar to her husband.

==Activities==
She lived on the Aybara farm with the rest of Perrin's family. [[Padan Fain]] murdered Perrin's entire family including Magde. Their deaths are blamed on Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|29}}
